project_overview: This project appears to be a web application for managing student admissions and course selections. It utilizes a layered architecture, with components likely responsible for data fetching, UI rendering, and application logic. The project exhibits some complexity through numerous components and imports, raising concerns about maintainability and potential fragility. The presence of several 'StudentSearchComponent' references suggests a core functionality focused on student data retrieval.

layers.description: Handles user interface rendering and interaction.
Contains application logic and data processing.

macro_trends.title: Component Import Over-Reliance
macro_trends.description: Multiple components, particularly 'StudentSearchComponent' and associated imports ('elementCount.js', 'test.js'), are excessively used within other components. This suggests a potential lack of clear responsibilities and could lead to tightly coupled code and increased maintenance overhead. The deep prop-drilling identified in the audit goals reinforces this concern.

macro_trends.title: Potential Circular Dependencies
macro_trends.description: The import of 'test.js' by 'StudentSearchComponent' and the related import of 'test.js' by 'test.js' suggests a potential, though not immediately confirmed, circular dependency chain. This could lead to unpredictable behavior and difficulty in debugging.

key_workflows.name: Student Data Retrieval
key_workflows.description: The workflow involves the retrieval of student data, likely initiated by components like 'StudentSearchComponent' and utilized within other components to display student information.

key_workflows.name: Course Selection Workflow
key_workflows.description: Components like 'iLikeCourses.vue' and potential interactions with 'SelectedApplicationService.vue' represent a workflow related to student course selections.
